objective: Reduce above-the-fold vertical space on the public BUKLOD Wall while preserving notification access, search, profile status bubbles, Community entry actions and media feed continuity.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA run #249 published update 01a1a62f-f53e-7569-4aef-306df0e0082b on production channel, Android runtime 1.3.2, from source SHA 4ed0d427b54c9ced99dfc0615b19f8cfac8dabab. This PR contains DEV UI density changes only.
chosenApproach: Reduce only redundant vertical padding, header/control dimensions and entry-card minimum height; preserve all existing actions, text accessibility labels, unread badge, scrolling, and media components.
selectionRationale: A compact top region returns usable viewport height to the feed without removing features or changing navigation semantics.
preserveBehaviors: Notification button and unread badge remain visible and actionable
Bible, Community and DZAS controls remain present and tappable
Search remains available above profile bubbles
Profile note editing and contact navigation remain unchanged
Life card title, copy and CTA remain visible
No media renderer, cache, signed URL, playback, ad or backend behavior is changed
acceptanceChecks: Global header minimum height is reduced while top safe-area inset remains applied
Community entry controls reduce height but preserve accessible labels
Profile avatar rail and spacing are reduced without hiding search or labels
Life card uses a smaller minimum height and remains legible
Focused UI contract and engineering accountability gates pass
Physical-device visual verification is skipped as explicitly requested
alternativeApproaches: Remove profile stories, search or top actions (rejected: feature loss).
Use negative margins or absolute positioning (rejected: fragile across font scales and screen sizes).
